description: This PHP source file defines the class ConvertUOM, which provides units of measurement conversions including categories, details, and the core conversion method CONVERT(). It supports various measurement units like weight, distance, time, pressure, force, energy, power, temperature, volume, area, information, and speed, along with their prefixes and conversion factors.

classes.name: ConvertUOM
classes.description: Provides static methods for units of measure conversions, including categories, unit details, and temperature conversion logic.

methods.name: getConversionCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of unique conversion categories (groups) for units of measure.

methods.name: getConversionCategoryUnits
methods.description: Returns an array of units belonging to a specified conversion category.

methods.name: getConversionCategoryUnitDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed information (unit and description) of units in a specified conversion category.

methods.name: getConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns array of metric multipliers for unit prefixes.

methods.name: getBinaryConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns array of binary multipliers used for information units.

methods.name: CONVERT
methods.description: Main function to convert a value from one unit of measure to another, supporting arrays and handling temperature conversions.

methods.name: getUOMDetails
methods.description: Extracts unit of measure details, including validating prefixes and determining the category and multiplier.

methods.name: convertTemperature
methods.description: Handles conversion between different temperature units, converting through Kelvin as an intermediate.

methods.name: resolveTemperatureSynonyms
methods.description: Resolves synonyms or different representations of temperature units to standard codes.
